options.systemMessage:
={{ 'AutoMate|' + $json.owner + '/' + $json.repo + '
T:' + ($json.executionPlan?.tasks ? $json.executionPlan.tasks.map(t=>t.id+'.'+t.task.slice(0,40)).join('|') : JSON.stringify($json.executionPlan||{})) + '
R:1tool/turn|str_replace>write|create_component(hero,card,pricing,features,cta)|run_build=last
X:parallel|rewrite|100+lines
⚠️ FILES IN CONTEXT: ' + Object.keys($json.fileContents||{}).join(',') + ' - DO NOT use read_file for these!
⚠️ DO NOT search_files for non-code queries (names, commands, questions)
M:' + ($json.memoryContext||'none').slice(0,300) }}

parameters.name: list_files
parameters.description: List files in a directory. Input: directory path (e.g., src/components or . for root)

parameters.name: read_file
parameters.description: Read file contents from GitHub. Input: file path (e.g., src/components/Header.tsx).

parameters.name: write_file
parameters.description: Create or overwrite a file. Input format: filePath|||fileContent

parameters.name: str_replace_file
parameters.description: Search and replace text in a file. Input format: filePath|||searchText|||replaceText. Search must match EXACTLY.

parameters.name: delete_file
parameters.description: Delete a file. Input: just the file path

parameters.name: search_files
parameters.description: Search for text patterns in codebase. Input: search query/pattern. Searches file contents using GitHub code search.

parameters.name: add_dependency
parameters.description: Install an npm package. Input: just the package name

parameters.name: generate_image
parameters.description: Generate an AI image. Input: descriptive prompt. Returns URL.

parameters.name: fetch_stock_image
parameters.description: Search stock photos. Input: search query. Returns URLs.

parameters.name: create_component
add_page
parameters.description: Create a new page with Next.js App Router. Input: page_path (e.g., about, pricing, contact)

parameters.name: get_file_tree
parameters.description: Get a complete tree view of the project structure. Input: max_depth (optional, default 3)

parameters.name: run_build
parameters.description: Check for build/TypeScript errors by running npm run build. Input: none required

parameters.name: create_checkpoint
parameters.description: Create a checkpoint of files before modifying. Input: comma-separated file paths (e.g., src/app/page.tsx,src/components/Hero.tsx)

parameters.name: rollback
parameters.description: Rollback files to a previous checkpoint. Input: checkpoint ID (e.g., cp_1704567890123)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ site_id: $('Parse Results').item.json.site.uuid, request_id: $('Parse Results').item.json.requestId, instruction: $('Parse Results').item.json.message, plan_json: $('Parse Results').item.json.plan, status: 'preview_ready', preview_url: $('Parse Results').item.json.previewUrl, files_modified: $('Parse Results').item.json.filesModified, files_created: $('Parse Results').item.json.filesCreated, files_deleted: $('Parse Results').item.json.filesDeleted }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ requestId: $('Parse Results').item.json.requestId, status: 'preview_ready', summary: $('Parse Results').item.json.plan.humanSummary, previewUrl: $('Parse Results').item.json.previewUrl, filesModified: $('Parse Results').item.json.filesModified, filesCreated: $('Parse Results').item.json.filesCreated, filesDeleted: $('Parse Results').item.json.filesDeleted, warnings: $('Parse Results').item.json.plan.warnings, iterations: $('Parse Results').item.json.iterations, toolsUsed: $('Parse Results').item.json.toolsUsed }) }}

parameters.text:
={{ 'Analyze this request and create an execution plan:

USER REQUEST: ' + $json.message + '

## VISUAL CONTEXT (Image Analysis)
' + (($json.content && $json.content[0] && $json.content[0].text) ? $json.content[0].text : 'No image provided') + '

Respond with ONLY a JSON object.' }}

options.systemMessage:
={{ 'You are a Planning Agent for AutoMate, an AI code editor.
Your job is to analyze user requests and create a structured TASK CHECKLIST for the executor.

## YOUR TASK
1. Understand what the user wants
2. Determine if this is SIMPLE or COMPLEX
3. Create a NUMBERED TASK CHECKLIST
4. ALWAYS include Verify build as the FINAL task

## SIMPLE TASKS (route to Haiku):
- Single text/string changes
- Simple styling (colors, fonts, sizes)
- Adding simple content
- Confidence > 0.8

## COMPLEX TASKS (route to Sonnet):
- Multiple files need changes
- New feature implementation
- API integrations
- State management

## MEMORY CONTEXT
{memoryContext}

## AVAILABLE FILES
{fileList}

## DIRECT RESPONSES
If the request is a question with NO code changes:
{
  "action": "respond",
  "response": "Your answer",
  "isComplex": false
}

## OUTPUT FORMAT - TASK CHECKLIST
Respond with ONLY a JSON object:
{
  "isComplex": false,
  "confidence": 0.9,
  "reasoning": "Brief explanation",
  "plan": {
    "summary": "What we are doing",
    "tasks": [
      { "id": 1, "task": "Find the title in page.tsx", "status": "pending" },
      { "id": 2, "task": "Replace with new text", "status": "pending" },
      { "id": 3, "task": "Verify build - check for errors", "status": "pending" }
    ],
    "estimatedTools": 2
  },
  "filesToModify": ["src/app/page.tsx"]
}

## RULES FOR TASKS
- Keep tasks atomic and specific
- ALWAYS end with: Verify build - check for errors
- Use verbs: Create, Update, Add, Remove, Fix, Replace'.replace('{memoryContext}', $json.memoryContext || 'No previous context').replace('{fileList}', Object.keys($json.fileContents || {}).join(', ') || 'No files loaded') }}
